text:
nina: FYI PR #5180 failing docs-preview: linkcheck flags external redirect to https://partner.example.com/docs -> 301 -> https://partner.example.com/docs/latest (linkcheck treats as broken). Also spellcheck caught 'configuraton' in the migration guide. CI: https://ci.redwood.ai/8123

docs-bot: docs-preview failed for PR 5180  checks: linkcheck (1), spell (1), vale (0). Details: https://ci.redwood.ai/8123/logs

omar: For the redirect, we usually prefer linking to the canonical landing page if it's stable. Can we change to /docs/latest?

rachel: If partner redirects often, we should add a note to the docs checklist to prefer archived permalinks. For immediate fix, update link to final URL.

ben: I'll take the spelling typo. Tiny change, no content-owner review needed.

kevin: Quick note: linkcheck fails when target returns 301 to a hostname with a trailing slash mismatch. Sometimes `make docs-linkcheck` with `--follow-redirects` helps locally.

nina: making two commits: 1) fix link to https://partner.example.com/docs/latest 2) spellfix 'configuraton' -> 'configuration' in migration.md. Running local linkcheck now.

ben: re: Vale, we had a new rule last week flagging 'utilize' but CI didn't flag it here. Good.

nina: local linkcheck shows success; pushed. Commit msg: `Fix: external partner permalink + typo in migration guide`

docs-bot: docs-preview queued for PR 5180  build 8123 started

omar: pinging for reviewer approval once CI green. I'll do a quick read for phrasing on the migration note.

kevin: small nit: in migration.md line ~42, reword "We recommend to utilize" -> "We recommend using". Not blocking.

rachel: approving after CI passes. Also added a follow-up ticket to docs backlog to add partner-link guidance checklist.

docs-bot: docs-preview success for PR 5180  all checks passed

ben: approved :white_check_mark:

omar: merged at 09:10 PT. Thanks.
